about: Read by scripts/check-landing.mjs (rule L8). Each term's first use on a page must link to its page or be defined there. pattern is a case-insensitive regular expression for the term's forms; it defaults to the term with an optional s. Only terms a newcomer would not know are listed, each in the sense BioMCP gives it: everyday words such as source, status and section stay out, and a word with a BioMCP sense is matched only in that phrasing.
